description: Compare one Google Data Commons statistical variable across every child place of a parent — e.g. population of all US states, median income of every county in Texas (geoId/48, County), GDP of every country in Europe. Returns rows sorted by value with names and the publisher of each value.

_apiKey.description: Data Commons API key (free). Get one at https://apikeys.datacommons.org

child_type.description: Child place type, e.g. State, County, City, Country

parent_place.description: Parent place dcid, e.g. country/USA, geoId/48, europe, Earth

name: datacommons_child_places
title: Datacommons Child Places
